question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
-- Full query: monthly top interest with rolling average and lagged values
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        im.month_year,
        im._year,
        im._month,
        im.interest_id,
        AVG(im.composition / NULLIF(im.index_value, 0)) AS avg_composition
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.month_year IN ('09-2018','10-2018','11-2018','12-2018','01-2019','02-2019','03-2019','04-2019','05-2019','06-2019','07-2019','08-2019')
    GROUP BY im.month_year, im._year, im._month, im.interest_id
),
monthly_top AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        _year,
        _month,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) AS rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        mt.month_year,
        mt._year,
        mt._month,
        mt.interest_id,
        mt.avg_composition AS max_index_composition
    FROM monthly_top mt
    WHERE mt.rn = 1
),
with_lags AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.month_year,
        tm._year,
        tm._month,
        tm.interest_id,
        tm.max_index_composition,
        AVG(tm.max_index_composition) OVER (
            ORDER BY tm._year, tm._month
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_avg_3m,
        LAG(tm.interest_id) OVER (ORDER BY tm._year, tm._month) AS prev_interest_id,
        LAG(tm.max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY tm._year, tm._month) AS prev_max_index_composition,
        LAG(tm.interest_id, 2) OVER (ORDER BY tm._year, tm._month) AS prev2_interest_id,
        LAG(tm.max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY tm._year, tm._month) AS prev2_max_index_composition
    FROM top_monthly tm
)
SELECT 
    wl.month_year AS date,
    im1.interest_name AS interest_name,
    ROUND(wl.max_index_composition, 4) AS max_index_composition,
    ROUND(wl.rolling_avg_3m, 4) AS rolling_avg,
    im2.interest_name AS prev_1_month_interest,
    ROUND(wl.prev_max_index_composition, 4) AS prev_1_month_max_index,
    im3.interest_name AS prev_2_month_interest,
    ROUND(wl.prev2_max_index_composition, 4) AS prev_2_month_max_index
FROM with_lags wl
JOIN interest_map im1 ON wl.interest_id = im1.id
LEFT JOIN interest_map im2 ON wl.prev_interest_id = im2.id
LEFT JOIN interest_map im3 ON wl.prev2_interest_id = im3.id
ORDER BY wl._year, wl._month
